name: M5.PrefixPartition.prefix_next
statement: ∀ (α : Type) (p q : List α) (a : α) (h : p.length < q.length), (p ++ [a]).IsPrefix q ↔ p.IsPrefix q ∧ q.get ⟨p.length, h⟩ = a
guidance: Forward shorten the prefix and compare getElem at p.length. Reverse use List.concat_get_prefix (h : p <+: q) (hl : p.length < q.length). List.IsPrefix.getElem identifies entries. All symbols are core List definitions. Return tactic lines only, without leading by, preserve target.
